item.title: DEFTONES Drop Video For New Single 'MY MIND IS A MOUNTAIN'; VIDEO
item.description: Deftones have released a new music video for their latest single, My Mind Is a Mountain (watch below). The track is part of their upcoming album Private Music, which is set to be released on August 22 through Reprise and Warner Records.

item.title: The Demos BLACK SABBATH Recorded Before They Were Famous Are Finally Coming Out
item.description: Before the world knew them as Black Sabbath, the band that helped define heavy metal was just four young musicians from Birmingham, England, playing under the name Earth.

item.title: LORNA SHORE Releases 'Unbreakable' Single and Music Video: 'It Will Never Break Us Down'
item.description: Lorna Shore has dropped a new single, “Unbreakable”, along with a fresh music video, giving fans another preview of their next album, I Feel The Everblack Festering Within Me.
